blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Taal Volcano in Batangas recorded a spike in volcanic earthquakes over the past 24 hours, ending several days of relatively low seismic activity, the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) reported Sunday, Nov. 15. In its latest morning bulletin, Phivolcs said the volcano registered 17 volcanic earthquakes during the 24-hour monitoring
